message:
1 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: interpolation reads `m` → "Delete the row"
description: The same sentence written as an attribute, which sets the directive's input as a binding does (measured: drawn). A written attribute hands the variable of its own name, `let-m="ngIf"`, and no other: a slot's name beside it (`pctWidgetSlot="row"`) is no value of `m`, and the refusal counts one.
